name: COLA renewal net oscillation / double-discount on partner maintenance
what_it_tests: Renewal maintenance COLA net must NOT re-apply the partner discount already netted into the COLA base; the deferred partner-pricing path re-discounts, causing the net to oscillate between correct and double-discounted across reprices
proc_mechanism: PartnerNetPricePosthook v1.4 buildRenewalMaintenanceColaUpdate returns null when procedureNet==colaNet then falls through to deferred partner path; v1.5 skips the deferred path when COLA-owned
expected_behavior: COLA renewal net stabilizes at correct value (e.g. base 71 x 1.0785 = 67.38 with prior 12% already netted), not oscillating 67.38<->60.64
test_setup: Renewal RRM line, COLA base 71, 7.85% uplift, prior 12% discount, reprice multiple times

prior_run.actual: Across 3 Force-reprices each on partner Renewal quote 00781389 (PD 18%/15%): NO oscillation (values stable run-to-run) AND no re-stacking, so active double-discount is suppressed. BUT net does NOT stabilize at correct COLA: beSECURE line 0QLWC000003kbxK Net=1453.47 (=COLACalc 5830.54 x 0.82^7, a 7x partner-stack fossil); BoKS New-Maint line 0QLWC000003kbxJ Net=null/0 vs COLACalc 3666.90 (=3400 x 1.0785). Async log proves posthook BUILT correct commit ('RENEWAL COLA COMMIT: ...kbxK procedureNet=1453.47 -> colaNet=5830.54' and '...kbxJ procedureNet=null -> colaNet=3666.90') yet engine kept the wrong net. Control quote 00781386 beSECURE Net=COLA=7110.41 stays stable (gate works).
prior_run.evidence: https://fortra--uat.sandbox.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/Quote/0Q0WC000003FRPZ0A4/view (line 0QLWC000003kbxK Net=1453.47 vs COLA 5830.54; line 0QLWC000003kbxJ Net=null vs COLA 3666.90); log 07LWC00000PfR142AF saved at Data/sc3473/j05_validation/reprice_main_log_07LWC00000PfR142AF.txt (RENEWAL COLA COMMIT debug lines)
prior_run.defectStep: COLA Uplift Net on Renewal (V21 committer) + PartnerNetPricePosthook v1.7 buildRenewalColaCommitUpdate
prior_run.notes: Two distinct behaviors. (1) The literal 'oscillation 67.38<->60.64 / active double-discount re-application' IS suppressed: v1.5 gate (PartnerNetPricePosthook L311-317 returns null for COLA-owned renewal lines before the deferred partner path) + v1.7 commit path are live; net is stable across reprices and an at-COLA line (00781386, 7110.41==7110.41) does not re-discount.
